title: MarsWalk Science Observation Record
description: Validated schema for scientific observations captured during planetary campaign sorties, supporting both simulated measurements and imported authentic rover telemetry.

observation_id.description: Unique identifier for the science observation with 'obs_' prefix.

sortie_id.description: Associated sortie ID during which observation was acquired.

mission_id.description: Associated baseline mission ID if applicable.

target_id.description: Scientific target waypoint ID where observation took place.

sol_index.description: Campaign sol index when observation occurred.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of observation recording.

observation_type.description: Scientific domain classification of the observation.

provenance.description: Authentic source provenance of the observational data.

instrument_name.description: Instrument or sensor payload used (e.g. Mastcam-Z, SuperCam, MEDA).

quantitative_measurements.description: List of quantitative measurements with strict SI physical units.

qualitative_notes.description: Scientific summary notes or geological descriptions.

evidence_references.description: Key-value citations to source telemetry, raster coordinates, or CRISM products.

confidence_score.description: Scientific confidence or data quality index from 0.0 to 1.0.

is_simulated.description: Flag explicitly indicating whether data is simulated (true) or authentic empirical observation (false).
